proposals.issue_title: Centralized Image API Router with Failover and Rate-Limit Resilience
proposals.current_pain_description: Individual pipelines hardcode their image API calls (or fail abruptly on HTTP 429/403). GH Actions IP blocks (Horde 403) and Gemini API limits (429) stall the entire production line without fallback paths, requiring manual intervention from Hugo's phone.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a core utility module `image_generator_router.py`. It accepts a standard prompt, size, and style. It handles backoff-retry (exponential), and automatically cascades through providers based on real-time availability: Together AI (FLUX-schnell) -> Cloudflare Workers AI -> Runware PAYG (if within 20€ budget) -> Pollinations (as fallback). Single point of failure eliminated.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Zero silent pipeline crashes; 100% automated recovery from API rate limits or IP bans.

proposals.issue_title: Automated Vision-Based Quality Gate (Gemini 2.5 Flash Filter)
proposals.current_pain_description: Pollinations or raw FLUX outputs can contain severe visual defects (e.g., gray fills in coloring books, broken anatomy, text artifacts). Hugo has to manually view every image on his phone to reject bad ones, wasting his 10 hrs/week budget.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a vision-based validation step inside `agent_visual_audit.py` using the free tier of Gemini 2.5 Flash. The model is sent the generated image and evaluates it against strict JSON-schema criteria (e.g., is_coloring_page_pure_bw: boolean, has_severe_deformities: boolean, quality_score: 1-10). If the score is below 7, automatically trigger a regenerate loop up to 3 times.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves Hugo 3-4 hours of manual curation per week; ensures only high-quality assets reach the staging folder.

proposals.issue_title: SQLite Flat-File Asset Registry for Mobile Status Tracking
proposals.current_pain_description: With 20+ pipeline scripts running on GH Actions, there is no centralized state tracking what assets have been generated, audited, approved, or published. Managing this via raw git files on Termux is highly disorganized.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a lightweight `registry.db` (SQLite) stored in the Git repository. GH Actions pipelines insert metadata (file path, tags, status: 'generated', 'audited', 'ready_to_upload', 'published') during runs. A simple python script auto-updates and commits the DB. A read-only GH Pages dashboard displays this DB in a mobile-responsive format for easy viewing on Hugo's phone.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Clear dashboard of 'Ready to Upload' assets on Hugo's mobile browser; prevents double-uploading or lost assets.

proposals.issue_title: Automated IP-Proxy Middleware via Free Cloudflare Workers
proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions runner IP ranges are heavily blacklisted by free AI hosts (like AI Horde, Hugging Face spaces) due to scraping abuse, rendering otherwise functional scripts completely useless.
proposals.proposed_fix: Deploy a simple, free Cloudflare Worker (using Hugo's existing Cloudflare credentials) to act as a reverse proxy. GH Actions calls the Cloudflare Worker endpoint, which forwards the request to the target API and returns the payload. This bypasses the GH Actions IP blocklist instantly.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Unlocks restricted free image generators and endpoints safely without paying for premium VPNs/proxies.

proposals.current_pain_description: Assets generated for one specific pipeline (e.g., a high-quality vector-style SVG for a coloring book) are stored and used only for that product, leaving significant passive income on the table.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a `cross_pollinate.py` script run by the Orchestrator. When a high-quality asset is flagged in the registry, it automatically runs transformation routines: 1) Converts SVG to high-res PNG for Redbubble, 2) Groups similar SVGs into a 'Vector Bundle' zip for Etsy/Cults3D, 3) Generates a standard 300DPI KDP interior page. All formats are linked under the same asset ID in the registry.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies the distribution footprint of a single successful design generation across 3-4 different platforms automatically.

proposals.issue_title: Automated USPTO and Copyright Clearance Gatekeeper
proposals.current_pain_description: Low-content designs, quotes, and viral texts risk infringing active trademarks (e.g., 'Boy Mom', 'Intellectual Property' phrases) which leads to instant account bans on Amazon KDP and Redbubble.
proposals.proposed_fix: Integrate a lightweight automated check in the text-generation phase of pipelines. Query a free, cached list of common litigious terms, and use Gemini 2.5 Flash to explicitly scan the output text for potential trademarks, copyright risks, or public-domain violations, returning a simple boolean clearance flag.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Protects Hugo's merchant accounts from automated trademark bots and permanent platform bans.

proposals.current_pain_description: Uploading from a phone is painful because Hugo must copy-paste long titles, descriptions, tags, and pricing parameters from raw text files or JSON outputs.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a post-processing script that generates a highly-readable, mobile-friendly `upload_card.txt` for every approved asset. This file groups metadata into clear, single-tap copyable blocks (e.g., one tap to copy all 15 comma-separated tags, one tap for the SEO-optimized description) and can be accessed via his phone through GH Pages or sent via a free Telegram Bot notification.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Cuts manual publishing time on mobile devices by 50% per product.
